precepts.why:
Zechariah's flying roll is “the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”, and the Lord says, “it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”. America is the house of the thief; this place was stolen. Second Maccabees names what that thief has done and what waits for him: “And thou, that hast been the author of all mischief against the Hebrews, shalt not escape the hands of God.”

They have been the author of all mischief against God's people. They even put out the story that they have ruled the earth since Genesis, with no mention of slavery, of Egypt, of Babylon or Persia, as if they were all of them, and some of our people believe it. Josephus records it: the Greeks became the authors of such mutations, and when they grew potent they claimed to themselves the glory of antiquity, as if the nations were derived from themselves. They say they are the first founders of everything, the first man, the Egyptians, everybody.

They do that because a lot of our people don't read, so we won't know our true history. It is all a plot against our people. But they are not going to escape the hands of God.

That is the curse that “shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof”: the judgment coming on America. Ezekiel says why: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword”. America is a bloody land, full of the blood of our forefathers and foremothers, with churches built on top. “Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”.

precepts.why: Read chapter one, verse one first, so we know the time period: “In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah”. So this vision of the flying roll was seen during the Persian captivity.

Christians love their two greatest commandments, and all you that teach on the street, listen well. “Master, which is the great commandment in the law?” “Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.”

“On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.” Meaning all the law is based upon those two laws, whether it is laws that pertain to God or laws that pertain to man. And what the prophets prophesied about was based upon whether or not you have love for God or love for man.

So when Zechariah reads the curse against him that stealeth, the prophet is speaking on the law: stealing from your neighbor breaks the law of loving your neighbor as yourself.

“Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark.” If you steal your neighbor’s land, you are cursed. That is the curse Zechariah saw going forth over the face of the whole earth against every one that stealeth.
Everything the prophets spoke about pertained to God’s laws. “Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless”. Did America break those laws? You better believe it.

Think about the witchcraft the media puts over people’s brains. The law said “Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark.” Whose land is this we are standing on? This is Gad and Reuben’s land. They stole the whole damn thing and convinced everybody that they discovered it. The people they stole it from, this was their house, and they relegated the inhabitants and put them in the bathroom of their own house, called reservations. Then they set up a United Nations building on top of the land they stole, where they sit arguing over wrongs other countries are doing, and the territory the damn building is sitting on is stolen. So what do these people mean by justice? Thank God for the Justice League we have been watching in these clips, and we ain’t talking about Superman, Batman and Robin. We are talking about God.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity”: the Most High says woe to them, and the white man devises iniquity. They “work evil upon their beds”: the white man works evil while they are lying down. “When the morning is light, they practise it”: when the sun rises they practice the evil they devised the night before. “Because it is in the power of their hand”: they came with the Gatling gun, all kind of weapons, bulletproof vests, all that technology, and slaughtered our people, then lied and called us the savages.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence”. Here is the part: the white man has never voted for a damn thing he wanted; he has always taken it by violence. That is his MO: violence, violence, violence. If you don’t believe it, because some of you just came out your mama’s behind yesterday, take a look at that fake Israeli state over there. They are taking it by violence. Ain’t no voting; they don’t vote for what they want, they take it.

“And houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” He oppresses the heritage too: now he’s the American Indian. Those damn $5 Indians on the reservations, the hell is going on here? He’s The Last Samurai too. It is always going to be a white man; that is what they always do.

They are all talking about how they love Jesus. Watch what Jesus said: “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy”. What is he talking about? Rome. Rome is the thief. Rome came to steal, to kill and to destroy, and this is the Saviour saying it.

Today they don’t call them thieves. They create new, nicer words: they are pilgrims, they are settlers, they are discoverers, they just need a home. Meanwhile they murdered millions of people to take what they want.

“I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.” Christ came to save us, to save your black behinds. So the thief of John 10 is the same thief the curse of Zechariah’s flying roll goes forth against.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.” “And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”.

That’s the reason why they don’t want us teaching: as we teach, those angels are being activated. Every time this Bible comes out and they try to hide it, the Most High is going to make them deal with it. The Most High is causing this word; when we speak, we speak the words of the Most High, and the angels are activated.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”: that’s what we were reading in Zechariah, “shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.” The Lord consumes with the spirit of the Bible spoken by the prophets. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: he shall destroy them with the brightness of the chariots. That’s exactly why what we read here goes along with what we read in Zechariah 5:4.
What does the woman in the ephah represent? “How is the faithful city become an harlot!” That’s talking about us. “It was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.”

“I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.” There’s the woman. So when you go back to Zechariah 5:7, “this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah”: that woman represents sinful Israel, and the angel calls her “wickedness”.

“Be in pain, and labour to bring forth”: the Lord don’t care about your battle fatigue. Everybody’s tired, we’re trying to get out of captivity, and he says be in pain and labour to bring forth. “O daughter of Zion”: that’s a message to us. “Like a woman in travail”: work like a woman in travail.

“For now shalt thou go forth out of the city”: we left out of the city of Israel. “And thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon”. That’s the same thing the angel told Zechariah: the ephah with the woman is carried to build it an house in the land of Shinar, Babylon.

“There shalt thou be delivered”: we’re going to be delivered from this place here.

note.label: Zechariah 5: The Flying Roll and the Ephah

points: “Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.” If you look at Christian commentary, because people get stupid, one group shows a biscuit flying through the air. Another group of Christians says it is a scroll of paper. A biscuit or a scroll of paper: both of them are wrong. This is talking about a chariot, and as we read it, it is going to prove itself.

“I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.” One cubit is about two and a half, let’s say three feet. Twenty cubits is sixty feet long, and ten cubits is thirty feet wide. That is no biscuit and no piece of paper flying through the air.

“Then said he unto me, This is the curse”. What’s that word? The curse. A piece of paper looks friendly, but out of the Bible this is not friendly at all. The Bible says this is the curse “that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”: this flying roll is a curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth.

Zechariah looks at the chariot and he sees words written on it: “for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.”

So it is thieves and robbers, and it is talking about major thieves. It ain’t talking about Tyrone that stole a pair of sneakers. It is talking about somebody that stole governments, somebody that stole nations, somebody that stole countries and kingdoms.
The law said thou shalt not steal. We interpret that to mean I shouldn’t take from you, and that is right, but it goes much broader than that: the stealing of a neighbor’s land.

Remember, this is the Persian captivity. Zechariah is looking up at the chariot, and he reads words written on it: “This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”. “For every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it”: as on this side of the chariot. “And every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.”

“I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts”: the Lord said he’s going to bring forth these chariots, the curse. “And it shall enter into the house of the thief”: the United States of America. And not just the United States of America: England, the fake land of the fake Israelis over there (that’s what the clip about Jerusalem showed), Australia, South Africa. These are places and locations, countries and cities, that the white man has stolen. The house of the thief starts with America, followed by Britain, England, South Africa, Australia and any other place where they done stole.
“And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”: they say they’re Jews, they say they’re Christians. They will swear they are Jews, they swear they are Christians. That’s what it means.

“And it shall remain in the midst of his house”: it ain’t leaving, brothers and sisters. These chariots are not leaving. “And shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.” Remember the argument: one group of Christians says it’s a biscuit flying through the sky, another group says it’s a piece of paper. Now what biscuit or what piece of paper can consume timber and consume stones? This is a chariot. Don’t let these Christian idiots ever, ever fool y’all.

Read it again with 2 Thessalonians 2 and it goes right along: “I will bring it forth”, the Most High is going to bring the chariots forth, because the prophets are going to speak it and cause them to be activated. “It shall enter into the house of the thief”: the chariots are going to enter into all those that oppressed us around the world. “Him that sweareth falsely by my name”: they blasphemed against the Israelites, they blasphemed against his Bible, and they’re going to pay for that. “It shall remain in the midst of his house”: they can’t get rid of it; they’re trying to stop it and they can’t stop it. “And shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof”: the Most High is going to destroy it all, burn it up, so it’s going to be totally liquefied. Why? Because the Most High is causing the prophets to bring it out, and the angels are activated to do just that.
That’s some powerful stuff: there’s going to be a time you’re going to be able to call the chariot, and it’s going to be right there.

“See what is this that goeth forth.” An ephah is not the ephod; those are two different things. An ephah is an ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure, equal to about a bushel. So it was a basket of sorts that held a certain amount of measurement.
“This is an ephah that goeth forth”: now he’s seeing something different. “This is their resemblance through all the earth.”

“And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.” Now he sees a woman in the midst of the ephah, that measurement; there’s a woman sitting in there. That woman represents sinful Israel.
“And he said, This is wickedness.” “And he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof”: the angel cast lead on top of the ephah to lock it in for this judgment, for us.

“Behold, there came out two women”: now he sees two women. “And the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.” They lifted up this ephah between heaven and earth.
“Whither do these bear the ephah?” Where are they taking the ephah with sinful Israel?

“To build it an house in the land of Shinar”: Shinar is Babylon, Babylon the great. Old Babylon was destroyed already, and this is the Persian captivity, so this Babylon is the future Babylon, which we are in right now. “And it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.” The angel is letting Zechariah know that Israel is going to be established in Babylon.

“And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.” The flying roll is more than likely a chariot. It’s not a roll of paper.
